description: Answer from lessons learned in real Godot 4 projects and on this machine: what went wrong, why, the fix and how to test it. Find them by `query` (words such as 'helicopter slides off moving ship', or a lesson id), `error` (a Godot message as printed), `rule` (a review or model rule), or narrow by `topic` (gdscript, physics, rendering, import, models, world, performance, gameplay, ui, audio, tooling, process); with none of them it lists the lessons. `gaps: true` lists the Godot errors seen here (and by other installs) that no rule predicts and no lesson explains yet. Use it when Godot shows an error you do not understand, and before you build moving platforms, vehicles, ships, large worlds, runtime-loaded models, shaders or headless tests. `detail` brief gives title and fix; full adds symptom, cause, test, rules and the message. Lessons learned here are marked. It counts shown lessons in the local learning file (GODOTWRIGHT_LEARN=0 turns that off); say whether one helped with godot_feedback (`lesson`).

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

error.description: a Godot error or warning message, as printed

gaps.description: list what Godotwright cannot predict yet instead of lessons

rule.description: a rule id from godot_review or godot_model_lint, e.g. api/infer-variant

name: godot_lessons
title: Lessons from real Godot projects
